units.title: Introduction to Business Communication
units.unit_introduction: This unit introduces introduction to business communication in everyday workplace settings.
unit_objectives: Explain the main concepts of introduction to business communication.
Apply these concepts in realistic office tasks.

topics.title: Communication Process

key_concepts.details: Sender, message, channel, receiver, feedback and noise.

activities.description: Prepare a workplace example demonstrating communication process and explain the steps you would take.

topics.summary: Effective communication process requires clear procedures, professionalism and practice.

topics.title: Types and Barriers

key_concepts.details: Formal and informal communication; language, distractions and assumptions.

activities.description: Prepare a workplace example demonstrating types and barriers and explain the steps you would take.

topics.summary: Effective types and barriers requires clear procedures, professionalism and practice.

units.unit_summary: Review introduction to business communication and apply the principles in a workplace scenario.
